build: Rule-generated brick bridge (src/vla_forge/hero_bricks.py). Every placement follows from the three rules (gap, pillar height, deck length); nothing is placed by eye. Parts are plain LDraw bricks.

conversion: src/vla_forge/hero_ldraw.py: sub-file recursion with BFC winding, LDU 0.4 mm, Y-down to Z-up, origin at the footprint bottom centre. Studs and underside tubes are kept in the visual mesh; physics uses boxes.
